title: The README Quick start works from the repository checkout before the package is published
description: Extract the README Quick start blocks: the first clones the repository, installs, builds and runs up from the checkout; the npx @cryptob1/graphyard line is labelled as available once published. Run the checkout block in a scratch directory, cloning this checkout instead of GitHub and linking its installed dependencies instead of npm ci (the network steps), building exactly as written and running the checkout CLI's up --help.
